question: Does a representation selected only from training runtimes reduce held-out same-unit solver-selection excess, and does any gain survive source-family shift?

family_split.family_key: first three nonempty slash-separated instance-id components, or all components when fewer than three
family_split.ordering: descending family size, then SHA-256(family key), then family key
family_split.assignment: greedily assign each complete family to the currently smallest fold, breaking ties by fold number

candidate_representations.menu: every dependency-closed subset of the ten declared feature steps
candidate_representations.objective: minimum training robust total excess; ties by training mean total excess, number of steps, then lexicographic step tuple

unseen_signature_fallback: training-only global robust action minimizing maximum training action regret

knn_baseline.target: training action regret for every portfolio solver
knn_baseline.numeric_preprocessing: training-median imputation, missingness indicators, training mean/std scaling
knn_baseline.tie_break: global instance-id order for neighbors and lexicographic solver order for predicted-regret ties

arms: training single-best solver by mean PAR10
training global robust solver with no features
all feature steps with training-only exact-signature policy
frozen Pre+lobjois with training-only exact-signature policy
training-selected dependency-closed representation with training-only exact-signature policy
16-nearest-neighbor learned selector on frozen Pre+lobjois information

cost_and_oracle.feature_failure: recorded feature cost when finite, otherwise the prospectively frozen feature-cutoff fallback
cost_and_oracle.total_excess: feature acquisition + selected solver PAR10 - statewise virtual-best solver PAR10
cost_and_oracle.common_baseline: the same statewise virtual-best solver with zero feature cost for every arm

metrics: p95 total excess using the higher empirical order statistic

strong_panel_gate.mean: strictly lower than no-feature robust, all-feature exact, and frozen-representation kNN
strong_panel_gate.p95: no larger than no-feature robust, all-feature exact, and frozen-representation kNN
